name: RRB Non-Technical Popular Categories (Graduate Level)
summary: Graduate-level railway posts such as Station Master, Goods Train Manager, Chief Commercial cum Ticket Supervisor and clerk-typist posts, through two computer-based tests, then an aptitude test or typing test depending on the post.

status.note: Railways now notify NTPC every year. CEN 06/2025 opened applications on 21 October 2025; CBTs followed in 2026.

posts.name: Station Master
posts.responsibilities: Running a station: train movements, safety, signals and staff.
posts.notes: CEN 06/2025: 615 posts. Needs CBAT and Medical A-2 standard.

posts.name: Goods Train Manager
posts.responsibilities: In charge of goods trains (formerly Goods Guard).

relaxations.note: After deducting military service from actual age, as per notice.

age.summary: 18 to 33 years on 1 January of the recruitment year (CEN 06/2025: on 1 Jan 2026; General/EWS born on or after 2 Jan 1993).

education.summary: A bachelor's degree (post-wise details in Annexure A of the CEN), held by the closing date. Candidates awaiting results are not eligible.

eligibility.medical: Post-wise Railway medical standards: Station Master and Goods Train Manager need high visual standards (A-2 / A-3 category).
eligibility.examVsPost: You choose posts in order of preference; posts with strict vision standards (Station Master, Goods Train Manager) are not open to candidates with weaker eyesight.
disqualifications: Candidates who have not completed the degree by the closing date are not eligible.
eligibility.reservation: Central reservation: SC 15%, ST 7.5%, OBC (non-creamy layer) 27%, EWS 10%, plus horizontal reservation for PwBD and ex-servicemen as per rules.

eligibilityRules.notes: Medical vision standards differ by post.

stages.name: CBT 1

papers.name: General Awareness (40 Q), Mathematics (30 Q), General Intelligence and Reasoning (30 Q)

stages.notes: Screening. Minus one third of a mark per wrong answer. Multi-shift scores are normalized.

papers.name: Same subjects at a higher level

stages.name: CBAT (Station Master, Traffic Assistant) or Typing Skill Test (clerk-typist posts)
stages.notes: CBAT is a computer-based aptitude test; typing is qualifying.

selection.meritCalculation: Merit from CBT 2; for posts with CBAT, CBT 2 and CBAT are combined as per the CEN. Document verification at a 1:1 ratio.
selection.languages: English, Hindi and regional languages including Telugu and Kannada.

sections.subject: Three subjects
topics: Mathematics: number system, percentages, ratio, time and work, interest, mensuration, algebra, geometry, statistics
General intelligence and reasoning: analogies, series, coding, puzzles, syllogism, data sufficiency
General awareness: current events, games, art and culture, history, geography, polity, economy, general science, computers

rankAndAllocation.text: Posts are allotted by merit, post preference and medical category, within the RRB you applied to.

salary.notes: Starting basic shown is Station Master (Level 6).

specialAllowances.name: Running allowance
specialAllowances.detail: Goods Train Managers get running allowance based on kilometres worked.

progression.post: Group B (Assistant Operations Manager) via departmental selection

career.promotionNotes: Railway promotions follow seniority and departmental selections; 70% and 30% LDCE quotas apply to some Group B posts.

benefits.detail: Privilege passes and privilege ticket orders for the employee and family, as per Railway pass rules.
Railway housing where available; free treatment in Railway hospitals and health units.
Non-gazetted railway staff have received a Productivity Linked Bonus each year (decided annually by the Cabinet).

workLife.postings: Within the zonal railway of the RRB; stations can be remote.
workLife.nature: Operational shift work for SM and GTM; desk for clerks.

difficulty.rationale: School-level subjects; lakhs of applicants; normalization across many shifts.

ratings.rationale: Now annual, but history of long gaps. Posting stays within your zone.

factors.note: RRB cycles have had multi-year gaps in the past; an annual calendar has been followed since 2024.
Notice to joining has often taken 1.5 to 2 years.
Weak eyesight rules out SM and GTM.
